problem: 'It is a loop, not a one-time form' — 'form' is unclear; a student may read it as an application form rather than a one-off activity.
fix: It is a loop, not a one-time step.

problem: The text says some syllabi call the first five stages (feasibility through validation) 'requirements development'. Feasibility is normally kept outside requirements development, which covers elicitation, analysis, specification and validation.
fix: Some syllabi group elicitation, analysis, specification and validation as 'requirements development', and keep the feasibility study as a separate, earlier check.

problem: The text says management runs beside every stage, but the diagram draws the management box with a single dashed edge to analysis only, and validation's feedback edge goes only to elicitation although the text says it can return work to elicitation or analysis.
fix: Show management connected across the flow (or label it 'side activity for all stages'), and either add a second feedback edge from validation to analysis or note in the caption that changes may return to analysis as well as elicitation.

problem: Cross-references appear as bare numbers ('2.3 covers how to run it', 'Links: 2.6, 2.7, 2.8'), so they are not clickable in the book.
fix: Make each reference an inline link to its chapter, e.g. '2.3 covers how to run it', keeping the same style for 2.4, 2.5, 2.6, 2.7 and 2.8.
